title: Muse Spark 1.1 adapter and benchmark evaluation
description: Build a bounded Meta Model API adapter and a reproducible cross-model benchmark packet to evaluate whether Muse Spark 1.1 belongs in the HUMMBL/Ownward model-routing stack under the doctrine 'The cheapest correct model wins only after correctness, safety, privacy, latency, reliability, and governance gates are satisfied.' The evaluation includes fixed benchmark tasks covering MCP reliability, governed delegation, repository execution, long-context integrity, computer-use safety, and cost-adjusted correctness, with security and failure tests. The outcome must be one of REJECTED, BOUNDED_USE, or PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE.
pain_point: Lack of verified benchmarks and a standardized adapter for Muse Spark 1.1 prevents informed routing decisions, risking silent fallback or incorrect promotion based on unverified vendor claims.
use_case: Evaluate Muse Spark 1.1 for inclusion in the model-routing stack by implementing a provider-isolated adapter, running bounded cross-model benchmarks with identical inputs and success criteria, and capturing cost, latency, correctness, and failure metrics to support a terminal decision (REJECTED, BOUNDED_USE, PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE).

title: 保持最新笔记简短精确避免截断
description: 用户需要一个机制来保持HVAC审查笔记的最新版本简短，确保ChatGPT/Codex工具能完整读取全文，并保留精确的笔记文本及元数据（页面标签、路由、URL、视口、用户代理、优先级、种类、可见上下文）。当收件箱过长或开始截断时，轮换到新的精确最新收件箱，避免丢失信息。
pain_point: 收件箱过长会导致笔记截断，ChatGPT/Codex工具无法读取完整文本，丢失精确信息和关键元数据，影响后续自动化处理。
use_case: 用户在处理HVAC审查笔记时，需要将最新笔记保持简短以便AI工具完整读取，同时保留精确的笔记原文和元数据（如页面标签、路由、URL等）。当收件箱过长或截断时，自动轮换到新的精确最新收件箱，并在操作前引用或总结最新笔记及来源页面。

title: First-party PDF viewer for sandbox artifacts
description: The sandbox platform lacks a built-in command to view generated PDF documents. When an agent produces a PDF via `gipity sandbox run`, it has no first-party way to visually confirm the layout. The agent must resort to a workaround: invoke a second sandbox command to rasterize the PDF to PNG images (using `pdftoppm`) and then use `Read` on each PNG. This adds extra sandbox round-trips, and the intermediate PNGs are auto-synced to the project and remote server, requiring manual cleanup. Every sandbox-generated document artifact (PDF, docx, etc.) will encounter the same friction.
pain_point: No platform command exists to view a generated PDF directly. The agent wastes time and resources: it must pay a full sandbox round-trip to rasterize, the intermediate PNGs auto-sync into the project and remote (requiring manual deletion via `rm` and `gipity sync`), and the same workaround is needed for every document artifact. The `--no-sync-output` flag unexpectedly discarded the needed files, forcing a re-run.
use_case: Agent runs a one-off data task (CSV in, PDF report out) via `gipity sandbox run`. After generating the PDF, it needs to visually confirm the layout before calling the task done. Without a first-party viewer, the agent hand-rolls a solution: a second sandbox invocation running `pdftoppm -png -r 90 docs/sales-report.pdf docs/preview` to rasterize pages, then `Read` on each PNG. This cycle repeats after fixing the chart.

title: Autonomous crank loop with push notification via GitHub app
description: Set up an autonomous crank loop from Fable to CLI that posts a summary comment to a pinned tracking issue on each queue execution, enabling push notifications through the GitHub app.
pain_point: The need to manually monitor queue executions without automatic notifications; the format requires shipping, blocking, and skipping status per item.
use_case: After each queue execution, a summary comment is posted to a pinned tracking issue, so Alex gets a push notification via the GitHub app.

title: Provide deterministic game loop stepping for verifying physics/animation games
description: Platform lacks a tool to step a running game loop deterministically, making it impossible to verify real-time physics/animation games (e.g., brick-breaker with ball bounces, collisions, scoring). The agent attempted to verify via `gipity page eval` but hit a warning about slow render (14.5 fps) and the suggestion to 'step the app's own loop deterministically' – yet no such mechanism exists. As a result, the agent abandoned real-time verification, took a static screenshot, and shipped the game with its core mechanic never exercised. This is a recurring issue for any canvas/physics/animation app on the platform.
pain_point: Agent had no follow-up move: it dropped real-time verification entirely, took a static screenshot, read the PNG, and shipped the game with its core mechanic (brick collision -> score -> win/lose transitions) never exercised. The verify step is the only step with no working tool for canvas/physics/animation apps.
use_case: Agent built a Phaser brick-breaker and tried to verify the real gameplay loop (ball bounces, bricks break, score increments, lives decrement) by driving the deployed page with `gipity page eval`. On the third eval that would confirm brick collision and score change, platform returned warning that page painted at 14.5 fps, that wall-clock waiting advances physics far slower, and that agent should 'step the app's own loop deterministically' – but no tool provides that. Agent dropped real-time verification, took a static screenshot, and shipped with core mechanic never exercised.

title: WhatsApp Business API Integration for Unified Inbox
description: Integrate WhatsApp Business API (via Meta Cloud API or Twilio) into OHC's unified feed to allow owners to receive and reply to WhatsApp messages without leaving the platform, capturing leads, tracking deposits, and maintaining customer history.
pain_point: WhatsApp messages are disconnected from the OHC ecosystem, requiring owners to constantly switch between their personal/business WhatsApp app and OHC, causing missed leads, untracked deposits, and fragmented customer history, breaking the 'One Assistant' promise.
use_case: Owners (e.g., Maya the Home Baker, Fatima the Food Cart Operator) rely on direct WhatsApp messages to capture demand, confirm orders, and coordinate pickups. They need to see and manage these messages inside the OHC unified inbox to avoid switching between apps.

title: Hive代理建议报告管理模式需求
description: 用户需要根据ACMM级别区分AI代理的行为模式，较低级别代理仅发布分析发现而不创建问题或PR，较高级别代理可直接创建问题或PR，其他代理保持仅建议模式；同时管理者发布定期摘要，且该问题作为动态文档不被关闭。
pain_point: 当前系统需要确保建议报告不被关闭，且代理行为需根据级别区分，否则可能导致建议丢失或管理混乱。
use_case: 用户在使用Hive系统时，需要代理以建议模式分析代码并发布发现，而指定代理可以创建问题或PR，同时管理者发布定期摘要，且该问题作为动态文档不被关闭。

title: Replace freeform args with privacy-safe versioned event schema for skill usage telemetry
description: Convert current skill usage log schema from storing freeform tool_input.args in TSV to a versioned minimal JSON event schema that only captures timestamp and skill name, removing raw args collection and using a per-host local random key to hash session IDs for privacy.
pain_point: Current hook stores unnecessary raw args payload that may contain private information, and does not provide health signal to distinguish between hosts with hook disabled and actual zero invocations, while the report only uses timestamp and skill name.
use_case: In the skill usage telemetry system, the log-skill.sh hook currently stores freeform tool_input.args that are not used by any report. The planned change moves to a versioned JSON schema with exactly 6 fields (schema_version, event_type, ts, runtime, skill, session_key), where session_key is a SHA-256 hash of a 32-byte local random key concatenated with session id, ensuring sensitive data like user, repo, args, prompt, cwd, raw session id are never logged.

title: run-da native fan-out lifecycle을 capability 기반으로 전환
description: Direct Codex surface의 문서화된 close_agent 부재 및 slot 수 불일치를 해결하기 위해, runtime mapping을 유지하되 실제 tool availability와 advertised slot에 기반해 current/legacy profile을 선택하도록 전환한다. 문서와 실제 API 간 차이로 인한 실패를 방지한다.
pain_point: 문서가 전제한 close_agent가 실제 surface에 존재하지 않고, root 포함 동시 slot 수도 문서의 고정값(6 threads)과 달라서, 문서대로 실행하면 실패하는 문제. 또한 feature 변경 없이 문서만 수정해야 하므로 실제 capability와의 불일치로 인한 오류가 발생함.
use_case: 개발자가 Direct Codex의 agent lifecycle을 문서대로 spawn_agent → wait_agent → close_agent, 기본 6 threads로 가정하고 작성했으나, 실제 codex-cli 0.144.1에서는 explicit close가 없고 active slot이 4개(root 포함)여서 FULL reviewer 4개를 batch로 띄우거나 없는 close를 호출하면 문서대로 실행이 실패하는 상황에서, 실제 tool availability와 advertised slot을 probe하여 적절한 profile을 선택하도록 수정한다.

title: Replace boolean tool outcomes with native error semantics
description: Refactor KhalaToolResult to use a closed union of success { summary, data? } and failure { summary, error } without the `ok` boolean, and use stable error codes like `invalid_issue_packet`.
pain_point: 当前使用布尔值`ok`导致成功状态冗余，验证失败被当作成功处理，并且增加了视觉负担；需要显式的成功或错误结果以消除歧义。
use_case: 在Khala运行时中定义和使用工具结果类型，其中`khala_triage.validate`当前将合规和非合规数据包都报告为成功执行（通过`data.valid: false`区分），而Pi适配器序列化完整的枚举为可见工具内容。

title: Hive agent advisory report management
description: Users need a mechanism for managing and viewing advisory findings from Hive agents, including periodic digest summaries and clear distinction between advisory and action-taking modes.
pain_point: Unclear how to effectively track and act upon advisory findings without manual effort, and risk of losing important insights as the issue is a living document that should not be closed.
use_case: Managing advisory findings from Hive agents that analyze code and post findings, but do not create issues or PRs at lower ACMM levels.

title: No AI tool demand identified
description: The discussion is a Renovate dependency dashboard with no user requests for AI tools. It lists rate-limited updates and detected dependencies.
pain_point: No pain points expressed; the dashboard shows rate-limited updates that require manual unlimiting.
use_case: Reviewing dependency updates generated by Renovate bot in a repository.

title: 学习使用 GitHub Copilot CLI 创建应用程序
description: 用户参与互动式 GitHub Skills 练习，旨在学习如何使用 GitHub Copilot CLI 进行问题管理和构建 Node.js 计算器应用。
pain_point: 缺乏使用 Copilot CLI 的知识和实操经验
use_case: 参与 GitHub Skills 练习，学习使用 Copilot CLI 创建 Node.js 计算器应用和管理问题

title: Make VoltAgent an ai-sdk-first outer framework
description: VoltAgent should become an outer framework around ai-sdk instead of a hidden abstraction layer, reusing ai-sdk names, options, semantics, and types.
pain_point: Current VoltAgent core API wraps ai-sdk calls through positional arguments, hand-written types, and parallel concepts like maxSteps, stop, context, UsageInfo, Tool, and LLMProvider, causing semantic drift, duplicated types, and blocked access to newer ai-sdk capabilities.
use_case: Aligning VoltAgent public generation APIs with ai-sdk v7 to reduce semantic drift, duplicated types, and blocked access to newer ai-sdk capabilities.

title: 追踪并修复 OpenAPI spec drift
description: 需要系统性地追踪并修复 @directus/specs 包与实际 REST API 表面之间的差异，包括记录未记录的路径、添加缺失的方法、修正不正确的查询参数等，以确保 OpenAPI 规范准确反映 API 行为。
pain_point: OpenAPI 规范严重落后于实际 API，存在大量未记录的路径和缺失的方法，导致文档不准确，影响开发者和贡献者的使用体验。
use_case: 对 Directus 项目中的 controller routes 与 specs 路径进行系统审计，对比发现大量未记录端点和缺失方法，目的是使 OpenAPI 规范与 API 表面一致。

title: 修复mockforge生成k6脚本时变量名包含点导致语法错误
description: 用户使用mockforge v0.3.2生成k6脚本时，生成的JavaScript变量名包含点（dot），导致k6运行失败，错误为Unexpected token。需要修复生成逻辑，确保变量名合法。
pain_point: mockforge生成的k6脚本中变量名包含点，导致k6无法解析并报Unexpected token错误，测试执行失败。
use_case: 运行mockforge bench命令生成k6脚本进行负载测试，使用OpenAPI规范billing_subscriptions_v1.json，期望生成正确的k6 JavaScript文件并能成功执行测试。

title: Automate setting required status checks for E2E workflows
description: The E2E robustness epic requires all 7 criteria to be green for 7 consecutive days. C6 (Required-status-checks) is the only blocker because none of the E2E workflows are configured as required status checks in GitHub branch protection. This must be done manually via UI or gh CLI, which is a one-time action but currently blocks the 7-day countdown. The user needs an automated or simpler way to set required status checks for the E2E jobs across three repos.
pain_point: The GitHub branch protection API cannot be set via Actions YAML -- it requires a repo admin to click in Settings UI or run gh CLI commands manually. This one-time manual step is the only blocker preventing the 7-criterion gate from being fully green and the cron from being disabled. Without this, the E2E robustness mandate cannot be considered complete.
use_case: A developer managing the E2E robustness epic needs to configure required status checks for E2E workflows across three repos (vivekchand/clawmetry, vivekchand/clawmetry-cloud, vivekchand/clawmetry-landing) so that PRs cannot merge unless E2E tests pass. The current state has all E2E jobs passing but none are required, which means PRs can merge even when E2E fails, breaking the 7-consecutive-day green requirement.

title: Hive agent advisory mode workflow management
description: Users need a clear understanding and management mechanism for Hive agents operating in advisory mode at different ACMM levels, including how digest summaries are posted and how advisory-only agents transition to creating issues/PRs.
pain_point: Lack of clarity on how advisory-mode agents' findings are systematically acted upon, and potential need for manual intervention to convert advisory findings into actionable items, causing workflow friction or missed issues.
use_case: A developer or project maintainer uses Hive with agents at various ACMM levels; some agents work in advisory mode, posting findings but not creating issues or PRs, while others can directly open issues/PRs; the governor posts periodic digest summaries. The context involves monitoring and integrating agent findings into development workflow.

title: Evidence-driven skill miss tracking with automated adherence classification
description: Set up a system to track real Praxis skill misses discovered during implementations, audits, and migrations, with adherence classification (already-supported-ux, already-supported-misnamed, partially-supported, real-contract-gap) and risk assessment, to avoid creating skills just for increasing count.
pain_point: Without evidence-driven criteria, skills may be created arbitrarily to inflate count (e.g., from 161 to 180/198/200) without addressing real gaps, leading to wasted effort and platform coupling (e.g., creating a skill per component or duplicating skills by package alias when existing family can be curated).
use_case: User is defining a workflow to record evidence of skill misses when implementing new platform capabilities, fixing CI/PR in Praxis repos, using skills in Ergon migration, auditing source drift in complex packages, or publishing docs/playgrounds/examples that mirror public contracts.

title: Local coding model with large context and anti-loop protection
description: Users desire a local AI coding model that can handle large context sizes (e.g., 90K context) and effectively avoid getting stuck in infinite loops, which requires constant babysitting. The ideal model should be lightweight, easy to run on consumer hardware, and have strong engineering judgment, debugging discipline, and verification culture.
pain_point: Context size becomes the biggest bottleneck, not raw benchmark scores; many coding agents get stuck in loops and require constant babysitting, wasting time and user attention.
use_case: Run local coding agents on consumer hardware (RX 9070 XT 16GB + 3060ti 8GB) to build applications such as arcade-quality Snake games, CLI task managers, version control systems, and log analyzers, evaluating models through blind engineering benchmarks.

title: Allow switching execution context to Dedicated Workers
description: Introduce an API to list all available execution contexts (main thread, dedicated workers) and set the active context for mcp-server, so that subsequent Runtime.evaluate calls execute within that worker's global scope, replicating DevTools context-switching functionality.
pain_point: Unable to interact with the dedicated worker's scope. Cannot run commands to inspect live objects that exist only within the worker, limiting debugging and automation for multi-threaded applications.
use_case: Integrating mcp-server into the Neo.mjs framework workflow to give AI agent Gemini 2.5 Pro the ability to 'see' and interact with the UI. The framework is built on an Off the Main Thread architecture where application logic runs inside workers. Need to run commands like `Neo.get('my-component-id')` to inspect live objects that exist only within a worker.

title: 修复 gh shim 递归选择另一个 aidevops shim 的缺陷
description: 用户发现 aidevops 的 gh shim 在热部署后，当 PATH 中同时存在不可变运行时包 shim 和可变安装 shim 时，会递归地选择另一个 aidevops shim 作为下游可执行文件，导致无限递归超时，所有 gh 操作（如 gh --version、gh auth status、gh issue view 等）均失败，并且紧急绕过变量 AIDEVOPS_GH_SHIM_DISABLE=1 同样失效。用户期望 shim 必须解析一个可信赖的原生 GitHub CLI 可执行文件，并最多经过一个 aidevops shim 后调用它。
pain_point: shim 的 _find_real_gh() 函数仅排除自己的目录，当存在两个不同代际的 aidevops shim 时，运行时包 shim 会选择安装 shim，安装 shim 又选择运行时包 shim，导致无限递归直到超时；即使是配置的紧急绕过（AIDEVOPS_GH_SHIM_DISABLE=1）也使用了同样的有缺陷的解析器，因此同样超时；这导致所有依赖 gh 的框架辅助工具和长期运行的自动化脚本失效，而直接使用 /usr/bin/gh 检查 API 和配额却显示正常。
use_case: 用户在一个长期运行会话中，PATH 以不可变运行时包 agents/scripts 目录开头，后又包含可变安装的 agents/scripts 目录（均在原生 GitHub CLI 之前），运行 gh --version 或任何 GitHub 操作（如 gh auth status、gh issue view、gh pr operations、diagnostics、pulse routines 等），期望该命令迅速完成并执行原生 GitHub CLI 一次，但实际结果是无限递归超时。

title: Fix Renovate's failed dependency lookup for Docker images
description: Renovate failed to look up docker packages `registry.cn-qingdao.aliyuncs.com/dataease/dataease` and `hectorqin/reader`, returning 'no-result'. These dependencies cannot be automatically updated until the lookup issue is resolved.
pain_point: Renovate returns 'Failed to look up docker package' with 'no-result' for specific images, blocking automatic updates and requiring manual intervention or configuration changes.
use_case: Managing Docker image dependency updates for an app store using Renovate; expecting all dependencies to be automatically found and updated, but encountering lookup failures for custom/private registries.

title: 远程版本探测组件需有独立超时和明确诊断
description: 当 homeboy status 命令执行远程版本收集时，若某个组件探测卡住，整个命令会无限期等待超过 120 秒，无法定位具体卡住的组件。需要为每个远程探测（网络、git、SSH、release、组件等）设置独立的超时时间，超时后返回明确诊断信息，说明哪个组件失败或超时，而不是静默跳过或完全阻塞。
pain_point: 命令在远程版本收集阶段无限期卡住，无输出，无法定位具体哪个组件探测失败或超时，超时的子进程组未被清理。
use_case: 用户运行 `homeboy status wp-build-runtime --timings` 期望获取阶段进度和仪表盘，但命令在 `fetch_remote_versions` 阶段卡住超过 120 秒，无法完成状态报告。

title: Show free-shipping progress after add-to-cart
description: Include free shipping progress (threshold, remaining, qualified) in the add_to_cart tool response when threshold is configured, using the existing helper to compute from real cart total, to nudge shoppers to add more for free shipping at the highest-leverage moment.
pain_point: Currently, the add_to_cart response does not carry free shipping progress, so the assistant misses the best chance to lift order value by nudging 'add $X more for free shipping' right after adding an item.
use_case: When a shopper adds an item to cart, the assistant should immediately show how much more they need for free shipping to increase order value.

title: Multi-agent code audit with automatic verification and duplicate merging
description: A system that uses multiple AI agents to automatically audit codebases, with each finding independently verified by two agents and duplicates merged, reducing manual effort and ensuring robustness.
pain_point: Manual verification is needed for conflicting findings (19 refuted, 10 split verdict), and duplicate findings (14 duplicates merged) require extra effort to reconcile.
use_case: The user conducted a multi-agent adversarial code audit of ~42k lines of code, where 16 reviewers swept across modules, each finding was handed to 2 independent agents to refute it, and duplicates were merged (12 found independently by 2–3 reviewers). The result was 127 unique confirmed issues.

title: 修复外部启动的Spring程序崩溃（代码0）
description: 用户报告外部启动的Spring程序崩溃，错误代码0，需要修复崩溃问题以确保程序正常运行。
pain_point: 程序启动后立即崩溃，无法正常使用，导致工作流程中断。
use_case: 用户外部启动Spring程序时程序崩溃，错误代码为0，期望程序能稳定运行。

title: Add Sparkle to Scoop package manager
description: Users want Sparkle to be available via Scoop package manager, allowing installation with 'scoop install sparkle' and updates with 'scoop update sparkle', providing a more integrated workflow for developers and power users who prefer Scoop.
pain_point: Sparkle can only be installed via the official website's .exe installer or Chocolatey, meaning users who prefer Scoop have no streamlined way to install and update Sparkle through their preferred tool.
use_case: Users who prefer Scoop for package management want to install Sparkle using 'scoop install sparkle' and update it with 'scoop update sparkle' instead of using the official website's .exe installer or Chocolatey.

title: 无明确AI工具需求
description: 当前讨论为Renovate依赖仪表板，仅列出依赖更新状态和检测到的依赖，未包含用户对AI工具的功能需求、痛点或使用场景描述。
pain_point: 未识别到具体痛点
use_case: 未识别到具体使用场景

title: Public Success Showcase & Cumulative Impact Dashboard
description: Build a public-facing dashboard displaying cumulative impact metrics (total PRs created, time saved, issues resolved, cost per issue) with anonymized examples of successful pipeline runs, and generate shareable HTML reports with before/after diffs, execution timeline, and cost breakdown to drive adoption.
pain_point: Zero pipeline activity suggests an adoption problem; success is not visible enough to drive adoption.
use_case: Strategic Intelligence Agent proposes creating a public showcase dashboard to display cumulative impact of the AI tool (PRs created, time saved, issues resolved, cost per issue) with anonymized successful pipeline runs, and generate shareable HTML reports including before/after diffs, execution timeline, and cost breakdown, to make success visible and compelling to drive adoption.

title: Multi-Agent Coordination Health Monitor with Deadlock Detection
description: Build a real-time monitor that tracks agent task completion, detects stuck agents, identifies coordination bottlenecks, and triggers auto-recovery (task reassignment, agent restart, or escalation to PM agent) to reduce coordination-related failures by 40%+ in multi-agent scenarios.
pain_point: Team-based pipelines fail due to agent coordination issues (deadlocks, blocking, idle agents) that don't show up in single-agent scenarios, causing undetected coordination failures and overall pipeline failure.
use_case: In team-based pipelines, monitor all active agents' heartbeat and task progress in team sessions, detect deadlock conditions (circular blocking, all agents idle with pending work), identify bottleneck agents (consistently slow task completion vs peers), and auto-trigger recovery: reassign tasks from stuck agents, restart hung agents, escalate to PM, with dashboard integration showing real-time agent health.

title: 修复SYSTEM_PROMPT中工具名'query_multimodal_ai'与实际注册名'query_multimodal_api'不一致
description: 系统提示词在config.py:198中引用工具名为'query_multimodal_ai'，但MCP服务器在mcp_general_tools/mcp_server.py:98将其注册为'query_multimodal_api'。这导致模型按照提示词调用不存在的工具，每次调用失败，需额外纠正迭代或导致视觉分析失败。建议将提示词中的名称改为'query_multimodal_api'或重命名注册工具以匹配。
pain_point: 模型调用不存在的工具，每次调用失败，额外增加一次纠正迭代；部分不重试的模型直接导致视觉分析失败，降低自动化效率并可能遗漏关键信息。
use_case: 多智能体审计中，系统提示词指示模型在拍摄相机快照后使用'query_multimodal_ai'进行视觉分析，但实际工具名称为'query_multimodal_api'，导致模型调用不存在的工具。

title: 改进2048 AI的启发式算法以追求更高分数
description: 用户认为当前2048 AI的启发式算法仍有改进空间，希望进一步优化以实现更高分数，特别是达到65536方块。
pain_point: 当前启发式算法仍有改进空间，尚未达到最优，导致AI从未达到65536方块，且32768方块的比例仍有提升空间。
use_case: 开发和测试2048 AI，通过优化启发式算法（如单调性惩罚、潜在合并数量）和权重元优化（CMA-ES），使AI在测试中实现更高分数（例如32768方块比例超过1/3，目标65536）。

title: 大型企业级Magento项目开发中保持上下文的AI工具需求
description: 用户正在寻找用于大型企业级Magento项目开发的最佳AI工具，要求能够在不丢失上下文的情况下工作。用户当前使用Claude Code，希望了解是否有更好或组合的AI工具可以提供更好的效果。
pain_point: 使用Claude Code在大型企业级项目中可能丢失上下文，导致开发效率下降或需要频繁手动恢复上下文。
use_case: 在大型企业级Magento项目中进行开发和编码，要求不丢失上下文。用户目前使用Claude Code，想寻找更优的单一工具或组合方案。

title: 通过WebView2控件获取Bing AI COPILOT输出
description: 用户希望在Windows窗体C#应用中通过WebView2控件保存Bing AI工具（COPILOT）的输出，但发现HTML表单中相关部分未包含在输出中，寻求解决方案。
pain_point: WebView2控件的HTML输出缺少涉及Bing AI（COPILOT）输出部分的内容，导致无法捕获并保存所需数据。
use_case: 在Windows窗体C#应用程序中，使用WebView2控件与Bing AI（COPILOT）交互，并希望获取并保存其完整输出。

title: Passing credentials for row-level security with Microsoft Fabric AI tools and service principal authentication
description: Dominic needs to understand how to implement row-level security (RLS) in Microsoft Fabric when using AI tools like Fabric Data Agent or custom copilots, specifically for service principal authentication where the end user is not logged in. He has explored semantic models, warehouse, and lakehouse without finding a solution, and requires credentials to propagate through the request while having the AI tool respect RLS.
pain_point: Unable to find how to pass credentials from the request to the database and have the copilot respect RLS when the user is not logged in (service principal), despite considering semantic models, fabric warehouse, and lakehouse as storage solutions; struggled to find an answer for this use case.
use_case: Building a front-end application that queries data through AI tools (e.g., Fabric Data Agent or custom copilot) but must enforce row-level security so users only see data they are authorized to access, using service principal authentication (no user login).

title: Integrate Claude AI into ML project for data analysis, text processing, predictions
description: The user is working on a machine learning project and wants to know if Claude AI can be integrated into their application for tasks like data analysis, text processing, predictions, or building intelligent features. They are seeking the best way to use Claude in such a project.
pain_point: Uncertainty about whether Claude AI can be used for these specific ML-related tasks and how to best integrate it, lacking clear guidance or assurance.
use_case: Working on a machine learning project; wants to integrate Claude AI into the application for tasks such as data analysis, text processing, predictions, or building intelligent features within an ML-based system.

title: 用AI工具智能比较HTML表格相似性
description: 用户希望使用AI工具智能地比较两个HTML表格是否描述相同概念，避免当前使用的机械的暴力方法（比较行标签集合的交集大小）。用户需要可访问的示例和指导，特别是如何指定表格的属性。
pain_point: 当前的暴力方法机械、不灵活，用户希望找到更智能的方法但缺乏入门示例和指导，对如何指定表格属性感到困惑。
use_case: 用户目前使用暴力方法通过比较行标签的集合来判断新表格是否属于已知类型，但希望用AI工具实现更智能、更艺术性的比较方法。

title: 从视频中提取摄像机运动关键帧
description: 用户需要从视频（如无人机飞行视频）中提取摄像机运动关键帧，导出为可用文件，以便输入到AI艺术动画中，并集成到个人AI工具colab笔记本。用户已搜索但只找到Blender的方案，希望获得Python脚本、库或colab笔记本。
pain_point: 唯一找到的解决方案只在Blender中，而用户需要可编程的Python工具，且不知道从何开始。
use_case: 从无人机飞行视频中提取摄像机关键帧运动，输入到AI艺术动画，并加入个人AI工具colab笔记本中。

title: Check if a deviation has "created using AI tools" disclaimer via DeviantArt API
description: User is trying to use the DeviantArt API to check if a deviation has a "created using AI tools" disclaimer. They wrote Python code to retrieve extended metadata but the response does not include the AI notice. They ask if there is a different API endpoint to check this.
pain_point: The API response for extended metadata does not include the AI notice disclaimer, making it impossible to check via that endpoint.
use_case: Using DeviantArt API, authorizing and retrieving a deviation's extended metadata with Python code, expecting to find the "created using AI tools" disclaimer in the response.

title: Kaggle skills vs AI tokens: success dependence
description: User queries whether success in Kaggle competitions today depends more on actual skill or on spending more on AI tokens for automation, given the impact of AI on similar platforms like HackTheBox.
pain_point: Uncertainty about whether personal skill can compete with AI-assisted tooling and token expenditure, risking reduced value of genuine competence.
use_case: Getting into Kaggle and evaluating whether skill still plays a major role or if success primarily comes down to spending more on AI tokens and automating routine tasks.

title: Safe AI integration with human oversight and output validation
description: User needs best practices and proven patterns (e.g., human-in-the-loop, output validation layers) to safely integrate AI tools into production workflows, addressing issues like confident but subtly incorrect outputs, edge-case bugs in generated code, and inadequate human review.
pain_point: AI produces confident but subtly incorrect outputs; introduces edge-case bugs in generated code; team members may accept AI responses without fully reviewing them, risking technical debt and reduced reliability.
use_case: Integrating AI (LLMs) into production workflows for content drafting, code suggestions, and internal automation, with concerns about long-term quality and reliability.

title: CREW AI tool not using ChatGroq integration issue
description: The user is unable to use ChatGroq with CREW AI's tool system. They have configured the tool in tools.py and agents.py, but running the code results in an error. They are seeking a solution to properly integrate ChatGroq.
pain_point: The integration between CREW AI's tool system and ChatGroq fails, causing an error that blocks the user from running their multi-agent setup. The user has followed documentation but still cannot resolve the issue.
use_case: Setting up a CREW AI agent with ChatGroq as the LLM provider. The user has defined a tool in tools.py, added it in agents.py, and assigned it to each agent. Upon execution, an error occurs preventing the tool from functioning.

title: Methodology to search for coding solutions before using AI tools
description: User describes a habitual over-reliance on AI tools to solve coding problems, fearing it degrades problem-solving, thinking, focus, and understanding. They seek a structured methodology to independently search for solutions before resorting to AI.
pain_point: Immediately running to AI tools bypasses the user's own problem-solving process, causing fear that it kills thinking skills, focus, and understanding, leading to a cancerous erosion of core technical abilities.
use_case: Facing a difficult technical issue while writing code, user wants to search for and solve it independently before turning to AI tools, to preserve cognitive skills and avoid replacing their own brain with the machine.

title: Generate PPT from Excel rows using free AI tools
description: User wants to automatically create a PowerPoint presentation with one slide per row from an Excel sheet, using free AI tools. The Excel has multiple fields, and the user may select multiple rows (up to 300) to generate corresponding slides.
pain_point: Manually creating one slide per row from an Excel sheet with up to 300 rows is time-consuming and repetitive; user needs an automated solution using free AI tools.
use_case: User has an Excel sheet with several fields and wants to generate a PPT with one slide per row (for selected multiple rows). The input Excel sheet has two rows as sample, and the user manually created one slide as example. The number of rows can be up to 300.

title: AI SDK: Prevent LLM from Repeating Tool Output as Markdown
description: 用户希望在使用AI SDK streamText()时，LLM生成的文本结果仅提供简短摘要，而不要重复工具输出的完整Markdown内容。工具结果应仅作为UI组件渲染。用户尝试调整系统提示无效，需要SDK层面的配置支持。
pain_point: LLM在文本结果中自动重复工具输出的完整Markdown格式内容，导致UI冗余；即使调整系统提示也无法抑制此行为。
use_case: 使用AI SDK streamText()开发聊天界面，期望工具结果渲染为UI组件，LLM仅生成简短上下文摘要而非重复Markdown内容。

title: 在spring-ai中使用OpenRouter Gemini模型的tools支持
description: 用户希望spring-ai的tools和MCP集成功能能够与OpenRouter上的Gemini模型兼容工作，当前仅OpenAI模型正常，Gemini模型产生警告、幻觉和错误，需要找到配置方法使tools在非OpenAI模型上也能正常运行。
pain_point: Gemini模型在spring-ai的tools功能下无法正常工作：调用时出现警告（warning when using model）、结果幻觉（result is hallucinated）以及最终报错（error out），无法像统一API预期那样支持工具调用，导致集成失败。
use_case: 使用spring-ai框架，通过OpenRouter统一API调用Gemini模型，并集成Filesystem MCP Server工具，期望像OpenAI模型一样正常调用工具并返回准确结果。用户已配置spring-ai相关properties，但注释某行后虽能运行但结果幻觉。

title: Generate test cases from English to executable code with debugging
description: The user seeks an AI tool that allows writing test cases in plain English, converts them to executable test code (JavaScript, Java, Python, etc.), assists in debugging failed tests by suggesting fixes, and helps with maintaining/refactoring test code when the application changes. Preference for free/open-source or without heavy enterprise license.
pain_point: Currently, manually writing test cases from English requirements is time-consuming and error-prone, and debugging failed tests and maintaining/refactoring test code as applications evolve is difficult without automated assistance.
use_case: Write test cases in plain English, convert them into executable test code (e.g., JavaScript, Java, Python), get debugging support for failed tests (suggest fixes), and receive help with maintaining or refactoring test code when the application changes.

title: 验证Monorepo完整上下文对AI代码建议的实际优势
description: 用户在前端多应用和共享库环境中，评估Monorepo（如Nx/Turborepo）相比Multi-repo是否能让AI工具（Copilot、Cursor）访问完整代码上下文，从而提升重构、跨应用变更传播和类型一致性的质量。用户希望获得实际生产环境中的验证经验，特别是TypeScript和共享领域逻辑场景。
pain_point: 在Multi-repo中，共享功能被重复实现或部分复用，导致不一致和Bug只在一个项目中修复而其他项目未修复；用户不确定AI工具在Monorepo中是否能真正利用完整上下文提升建议质量，缺乏实际生产验证的经验和对比数据。
use_case: 在前端多应用和共享库环境下，用户正在评估是否从Multi-repo迁移到Monorepo，以让AI工具（如GitHub Copilot、Cursor）在开发时拥有完整代码库上下文，期望改善重构触及共享API、跨应用传播变更、更新可复用方法或类型时的一致性，并减少复制粘贴导致的代码分歧。

title: File missing error in Azure AI search performance testing tool with load-test.yml
description: User has created a pipeline using load-test.yml for Azure AI search performance testing, but the script fails with an error indicating a missing file, preventing the conversion of test artifacts to output.xml.
pain_point: Script fails with error that a file is missing, blocking the conversion process and preventing successful performance testing.
use_case: User is using Azure AI search performance testing tool, created a pipeline using load-test.yml, expects to download test artifacts and convert them to output.xml format, but the script fails with a missing file error.

title: Fix mksdcard SDK tool error during Android Studio installation on Ubuntu
description: User is unable to run the mksdcard SDK tool in the Android Studio setup wizard on Ubuntu, getting an error that prevents successful installation.
pain_point: The setup wizard fails with an error saying 'Unable to run mksdcard SDK tool', which blocks the installation process and prevents the user from using Android Studio.
use_case: Installing Android Studio on Ubuntu via the setup wizard

title: 处理Spring AI工具调用中的后续确认上下文丢失
description: 在Spring AI 1.0.0中使用RAG动态选择工具时，当用户输入通用确认（如"yes"、"confirm"）或后续澄清问题（如"change the name"）时，需要保持原始意图上下文，避免重新触发工具过滤导致工具选择错误或操作不完整。
pain_point: 用户输入的通用确认（如"yes"）缺乏上下文，导致RAG工具选择逻辑失效，无法推断应调用哪个工具或完成什么操作，尤其是当用户有多个工具且需要连续确认或澄清时，状态管理和意图保留变得复杂。
use_case: 用户构建Spring Boot 3.4.5 + Spring AI 1.0.0应用，集成Llama3.2模型，通过RAG基于语义搜索过滤工具。当用户对之前的工具调用意图进行确认（如回复"yes"、"confirm"）或提出后续澄清问题时，系统应能够保持上下文，正确选择之前确定的工具并完成操作。

title: Pass runtime input variables to OpenAPI tool in Azure AI Foundry
description: User creates an Agent in Azure AI Foundry that calls an OpenAPI tool. Runtime input variables, including a bearer token, are not being passed correctly from agent input to the tool, resulting in empty/incorrect values or validation errors. User seeks a reliable method to pass runtime variables, preferably without relying solely on prompt engineering.
pain_point: Runtime input variables (especially a bearer token) are not being passed from agent input to the OpenAPI tool, causing validation errors and failed requests. Prompts alone are insufficient, and no alternative configuration method is documented or working.
use_case: Creating a Python-based Agent in Azure AI Foundry that invokes an OpenAPI tool. User passes a bearer token as input to the Agent and expects the token to be used in the API header. They tried various prompt styles but the tool still sends incorrect values or fails.

title: Post-hoc explainable AI tool for complex CNN architectures like Mask R-CNN
description: User is looking for a post-hoc, easily applicable explainable AI method specifically designed for complex CNN-based architectures such as Mask R-CNN, indicating a need for interpretability in object detection tasks.
pain_point: Lack of easily applicable post-hoc explainability tools that work with complex CNN architectures (e.g., Mask R-CNN), making it difficult to interpret detection results.
use_case: Applying post-hoc explainability to object detection models like Mask R-CNN for understanding model decisions.

title: Enable/disable tools in Spring AI + MCP Client
description: User wants to implement functionality to disable an entire MCP Server or a specific tool in Spring AI + MCP Client, similar to Cloud Desktop's feature. They propose a REST API for users to list and deactivate tools but are unclear on how MCP Client works within Spring.
pain_point: User does not understand how the MCP Client part works within Spring, and needs guidance on implementing disable functionality for MCP Server or specific tools.
use_case: User wants to create a REST API where the user could list active and deactivate tools in Spring AI + MCP Client, mimicking Cloud Desktop's ability to disable an entire module or a specific tool.

title: Propagate SecurityContext to boundedElastic thread in Spring AI MCP Server tool calls
description: When invoking a tool via the Spring AI MCP Server (spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc), the SecurityContext is not propagated to the boundedElastic thread where tool execution occurs. This causes a 'Security Context is invalid' error, as the tool requires the security context to determine parameters like organizationId. Attempts with SecurityContextHolder.MODE_INHERITABLETHREADLOCAL and a custom WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider did not solve the issue.
pain_point: Security Context is invalid error because the boundedElastic thread does not inherit the SecurityContext from the original request. Attempts to propagate using SecurityContextHolder.MODE_INHERITABLETHREADLOCAL or custom provider failed; the SDK's WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider uses boundedElastic internally, making it impossible to propagate context without modifying SDK internals.
use_case: Integrating a Spring Boot application with Spring AI MCP Server, where a client sends bearer token requests. Tool listing works fine, but invoking a tool fails because the MCP server delegates execution to a boundedElastic thread that lacks the original request's SecurityContext. The user needs the SecurityContext at the tool level to extract organizationId.

title: Invoke custom Spring AI MCP tools via SSE without response
description: User is unable to receive responses from Spring AI MCP server when calling custom tools via SSE from a Python client; tools/list and custom tool calls result in timeout even though requests reach the server.
pain_point: After sending tools/list or custom tool requests (e.g., getJob) over SSE, the MCP server logs show the request is received and mapped to WebMvcSseServerTransportProvider, but no response is ever returned to the SSE client, causing the Python client to time out.
use_case: Calling custom Spring Boot @Tool-annotated methods remotely via SSE using a Python MCP client, expecting the server to execute the tool and send a response back through the SSE session.

title: 使用Microsoft.Agents.AI构建自治AI代理的多步工具调用和安全架构
description: 用户寻求生产级示例或架构，以安全地管理自治AI代理的多步工具调用循环，并处理状态持久化、对话历史和代理记忆。
pain_point: 用户缺乏生产级参考，对安全地管理多步工具调用循环、状态持久化和跨会话记忆感到不确定。
use_case: 用户正在使用Microsoft.Agents.AI和Microsoft.Extensions.AI包构建自治AI代理，目标是为代理提供自定义C#工具（如数据库查询或内部API），使其能根据用户意图自主决定执行函数。需要管理多步工具调用循环，并处理跨用户会话的状态持久化、对话历史和代理记忆。

title: Free AI code generation agent in VS Code like Cursor

use_case: The user has an app plan and wants to use an AI agent to 'transit my plan into app'. They found Cursor but it is paid, and they are not able to pay for tokens at this stage.

title: Langchain4j和Quarkus AI Services无法调用带@Tool的远程GraphQL API
description: 用户在使用Quarkus Langchain4j构建AI服务时，无法让AI调用标注了@Tool的方法来访问远程GraphQL API，导致返回空响应，工具调用显示空消息。
pain_point: AI调用工具（@Tool）始终返回空响应，工具调用显示空消息，无法正确使用工具函数来调用远程GraphQL API。用户第一次使用Quarkus Langchain4j，花费了几天时间仍未解决，感到困惑和挫败。

title: Add 8955 chip option in CoolWatcher for A9G module firmware burning
description: User needs to burn firmware onto A9G (8955 chip) GPRS+GPS module but official Windows tools download link is dead, and Linux CoolWatcher burner lacks 8955 option. User seeks manual addition method or alternative GPS modules with proper tooling, and is concerned about company viability.

use_case: Burning firmware onto A9G GPRS+GPS module (8955 chip) using CoolWatcher on Ubuntu 16, following Ai-Thinker's C SDK documentation, but burner only lists chips 8808, 8808s, 8809, 8810, 8810-AP, Gallite-8805, Gallite-8806, missing 8955.

title: Build strong programming fundamentals without relying on AI
description: A beginner wants to develop solid programming fundamentals in logic building, problem solving, and understanding how programs work, without depending on AI tools. They seek effective practice strategies, learning resources, and study approaches to improve programming logic and conceptual understanding.

title: Understand the meaning of List entity count in LUIS
description: User wants to know what the 'list entity count' represents in LUIS AI tool, as they see this metric and are confused about its actual meaning.
pain_point: User lacks clear explanation for the 'list entity count' metric within LUIS, causing confusion about its purpose and meaning.
use_case: User is using LUIS tool and sees a field called 'list entity count (x/50)' and asks 'What is it actually?'

title: 分享AI工具列表

pain_point: 无明确痛点。
use_case: 用户浏览或收集AI工具信息。

description: 用户试用了数百款AI工具后，发现大多数都很普通、用过就忘，只有少数几款能让人眼前一亮。用户推荐了7款真正好用的AI工具，暗示对高质量、令人惊艳的AI工具有需求。
